results.name: Storm in Lombardy, Italy
results.reason: On the 28 August 2026, a severe storm is reported to have affected the province of Cremona, Italy, causing damage to public and private buildings, to infrastructures and roads, as well as fallen trees. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping is requested to provide damage assessment emergency mapping.
